45871-a-fleet-in-being-notes-of-two-trip.title: Notes Of Two Trips With The Channel Squadron
45871-a-fleet-in-being-notes-of-two-trip.creator: Unknown
45871-a-fleet-in-being-notes-of-two-trip.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. we nipped in immediately ahead of her, precisely as a hansom turning out of Bond Street nips in in front of a City ’bus. Distance on water is deceptive, and when I vowed that at one crisis I could have spat on the wicked ram of our next astern, pointed straight at our naked turning side, the ward-room laughed.

arxiv-1509-03249.title: Coarse-grained distinguishability of field interactions
arxiv-1509-03249.creator: Cédric Bény
arxiv-1509-03249.description: Abstract Information-theoretical quantities such as statistical distinguishability typically result from optimisations over all conceivable observables. Physical theories, however, are not generally considered valid for all mathematically allowed measurements. For instance, quantum field theories are not meant to be correct or even consistent at arbitrarily small lengthscales.

arxiv-1607-07666.title: Causal hierarchy of multipartite Bell nonlocality
arxiv-1607-07666.creator: R. Chaves, D. Cavalcanti, L. Aolita
arxiv-1607-07666.description: Abstract As with entanglement, different forms of Bell nonlocality arise in the multipartite scenario. These can be defined in terms of relaxations of the causal assumptions in local hidden-variable theories. However, a characterisation of all the forms of multipartite nonlocality has until now been out of reach, mainly due to the complexity of generic multipartite causal models.

arxiv-1809-06786.title: Studying Deformations of Fuchsian Representations with Higgs Bundles This paper is a contribution to the Special Issue on Geometry and Physics of Hitchin Systems. The full collection is available at https://www.emis.de/journals/SIGMA/hitchin-systems.html
arxiv-1809-06786.creator: Brian COLLIER
arxiv-1809-06786.description: Abstract This is a survey article whose main goal is to explain how many components of the character variety of a closed surface are either deformation spaces of representations into the maximal compact subgroup or deformation spaces of certain Fuchsian representations. This latter family is of particular interest and is related to the field of higher Teichmüller theory.

arxiv-2201-12469.title: ScaLA: Accelerating Adaptation of Pre-Trained Transformer-Based Language Models via Efficient Large-Batch Adversarial Noise
arxiv-2201-12469.creator: Minjia Zhang, Niranjan Uma Naresh, Yuxiong He
arxiv-2201-12469.description: Abstract In recent years, large pre-trained Transformer-based language models have led to dramatic improvements in many natural language understanding tasks. To train these models with increasing sizes, many neural network practitioners attempt to increase the batch sizes in order to leverage multiple GPUs to improve training speed.

arxiv-2205-08040.creator: Carmen Galaz-García
arxiv-2205-08040.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Carmen Galaz-García. arxiv-2309-11245.title: Speed of Sound and Phase Transitions in Neutron Stars Indicated by the Thick Neutron Skin of 208 Pb Preprint: August 9, 2026
arxiv-2309-11245.creator: Manjia Chen, Dawei Guan, Chongji Jiang, Junchen Pei
arxiv-2309-11245.description: Abstract The speed of sound is a novel probe of equation of state and phase transitions in dense cores of neutron stars. Recently nuclear experiments extracted a surprising thick neutron skin of 208 Pb, causing tensions to reproduce the tidal deformability in gravitational-wave observations.

arxiv-2402-18628.title: Probing the dust grain alignment mechanisms in spiral galaxies with M 51 as the case study aplpy ( Robitaille & Bressert 2012 ) , astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 )
arxiv-2402-18628.creator: Enrique Lopez-Rodriguez, Le Ngoc Tram
arxiv-2402-18628.description: Abstract Magnetic fields (B-fields) in galaxies have recently been traced using far-infrared and sub-mm polarimetric observations with SOFIA, JCMT, and ALMA. The main assumption is that dust grains are magnetically aligned with the local B-field in the interstellar medium (ISM).

arxiv-2409-15282.title: Modelling Fire Incidents Response Times in Ålesund
arxiv-2409-15282.creator: J. Christmas, R. Bergmann, A. Zhakatayev, J. Rebenda, S. Singh
arxiv-2409-15282.description: Abstract In the ESGI-156 project together with Ålesund Brannvesen we develop a model for response times to fire incidents on publicly available data for Ålesund. We investigate different scenarios and a first step towards an interactive software for illustrating the response times.

arxiv-2502-21030.title: Beyond Words: A Latent Memory Approach to Internal Reasoning in LLMs
arxiv-2502-21030.creator: José I. Orlicki
arxiv-2502-21030.description: Abstract Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have popularized the chain-of-thought (CoT) paradigm, in which models produce explicit reasoning steps in natural language. Although this approach improves interpretability and facilitates external auditing, it may not represent the most computationally efficient method for internal reasoning.

Müller, D. Rapagnani, A. Roberts, K. Römer, S. Turkat, K. Schmidt, J. Skowronski, A. Wagner, M. Wiescher, A. Yadav. The reaction 14 N ( n , p ) 14 (n,p)^{14} C is one of the main neutron poisons during s s -process nucleosynthesis. In addition, the reaction provides insight into the yields of atmospheric nuclear weapon testing.

Ray, Pierre Stammler, Serena Vinciguerra
arxiv-2602-23743.description: Abstract Pulse-profile modeling of rotation-powered millisecond pulsars targeted by NICER has enabled mass–radius constraints of several neutron star sources, with implications for the dense-matter equation of state. For the bright isolated pulsar PSR J0030+0451, the inferred mass–radius was previously found to depend strongly on the assumed hot spot model.

pmc-10588783.title: Risks Factors Associated with the Development of Crohn’s Disease After Ileal Pouch-Anal Anastomosis for Ulcerative Colitis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-10588783.creator: Michael G Fadel, Georgios Geropoulos, Oliver J Warren, Sarah C Mills, Paris P Tekkis, Valerio Celentano, Christos Kontovounisios
pmc-10588783.description: BackgroundFollowing ileal pouch–anal anastomosis [IPAA] for ulcerative colitis [UC], up to 16% of patients develop Crohn’s disease of the pouch [CDP], which is a major cause of pouch failure. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to identify preoperative characteristics and risk factors for CDP development following IPAA.

pmc-10616569.title: GLIOMA-07 E.R.A.S. IN NEURO-ONCOLOGY
pmc-10616569.creator: Mario Moro
pmc-10616569.description: BACKGROUNDWe performed a retrospective study assesses the efficacy and safety of a protocol for the enhanced recovery after surgery for supratentorial gliomas and metastasis.The protocol applied to the Ca' Foncello Hospital in Treviso starts from the recommendations on the subject that the medical literature reported up to December 2018.

pmc-10645929.title: App-based self-trainings targeting strain recovery and their effect on concentration
pmc-10645929.creator: Martina Hartner-Tiefenthaler, Julia Schoellbauer
pmc-10645929.description: During the COVID-19 pandemic, many knowledge workers reported concentration problems. This can be seen as critical as concentration is an important indicator for both cognitive wellbeing and occupational success. Drawing on the load theory of selective attention, we argue that concentration problems can be caused by the strain workers experienced during the pandemic.

pmc-11518563.title: Hospital policies as a tool to reduce gaps between ethnic groups of employees and patients
pmc-11518563.creator: A Gur, L Inchi
pmc-11518563.description: BackgroundAs diverse organizations, hospitals require an inclusive culture that respects and promotes ethnic diversity. Violence, a threat to this diversity, hampers effective organizational functioning. Our study delves into the positive influence of cultural diversity policies and communication about violence on the perception of the hospital’s atmosphere regarding ethnic differences among health employees.

pmc-12676172.title: High-Sensitivity vs Conventional Cardiac Troponin T in Non-ACS Hospitalized Patients
pmc-12676172.creator: Nithin Kumar Konanur Srinivasa, Sulochana Gnanasekaran, Canan Dilay Dirican, Dilesha Kumanayaka, Nirmit Patel, Raam Mannam, Hriday Shah, Saloni Brahmbhatt, Kunal Brahmbhatt
pmc-12676172.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundHigh-sensitivity cardiac troponin T (hs-cTnT) enables earlier and more sensitive detection of myocardial injury compared with conventional troponin assays. Although extensively studied in acute coronary syndrome (ACS), its role in non-ACS hospitalized populations remains less clear.Project RationaleIn patients admitted without ACS, hs-cTnT may improve diagnostic efficiency and reduce unnecessary testing, but it may also increase detection of ambiguous troponin elevations, leading to resource overuse.

pmc-12859995.title: Early-onset metastatic fibroblastic osteosarcoma of the metatarsus in a young cat: a case report
pmc-12859995.creator: Mojtaba Kiakojoori, Hossein Kazemi Mehrjerdi, Ali Mirshahi, Mahdieh Zaeemi, Mohsen Maleki
pmc-12859995.description: BackgroundOsteosarcoma is the most common primary bone tumor in cats, yet it is typically diagnosed in older animals and rarely metastasizes. Among its histological variants, the fibroblastic subtype—defined by spindle-shaped osteogenic cells that generate osteoid—is infrequently reported in young cats.

pmc-13508366.title: Unveiling intervention targets: urban-rural disparities in depression-anxiety symptoms networks among Chinese older adults living alone
pmc-13508366.creator: Yang He, Keiwei Sun, Wenqin Chen, Minghao Man, Ning Chen, Wei Liu
pmc-13508366.description: BackgroundLiving alone is a significant risk factor for depression and anxiety among older adults in China. However, geographic disparities in the symptom-level network structure of depression and anxiety remain unexamined. This study aims to investigate urban–rural differences in the depression-anxiety network to identify central and bridge symptoms as potential intervention targets.

pmc-13575704.title: Brazil at the Forefront: What Does It Take To Be Net‐Zero by 2040
pmc-13575704.creator: Gerd Angelkorte, Nathália Nascimento, Eduardo Delgado Assad, Luiz Bernardo Baptista, Mercedes Bustamante, Sabrina Matos Carlos, Fabio Diuana, Felipe Lenti, Núbia Marques, Susian Martins, Laura Vanini Polli, Melina Sampaio, Roberto Schaeffer, Daiane Pereira de Sousa, Alice Assad Wassal, Carlos A Nobr
pmc-13575704.description: Brazil's current Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) establishes a target of net‐zero greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions by 2050. Here, we use the Brazilian Land Use and Energy Systems model (BLUES) to investigate whether national GHG neutrality could be advanced to 2040.

pmc-13581888.title: Emotional regulation and music engagement: a meta-analytic synthesis
pmc-13581888.creator: Yuquan Feng, Hao Wang, Yelin Tan, Fuhong Wang
pmc-13581888.description: BackgroundThe use of music-based interventions has grown to support emotional regulation, mood improvement, stress relief, and psychological well-being in general, pediatric, and clinical populations. The research shows increasing evidence but maintains gaps in understanding how the treatments work across different populations.
